how_to_query:
# 1. Global listing + facets (total = 136 open reqs worldwide as of 24 Sep 2026)
curl -s -X POST 'https://fractal.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/fractal/Careers/jobs' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"appliedFacets":{},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":""}'

# 2. IMPORTANT: searchText is a fuzzy relevance search, NOT a filter. searchText:"India" returns 94
#    but many of those are US/UK roles. Use the location FACET instead for a true India filter.
#    India city facet IDs (from the "locationMainGroup" facet in any response):
#      Bengaluru  4fedd31659ec01018833637cbf900000   (61)
#      Mumbai     4fedd31659ec01018833886e5c060000   (43)
#      Gurgaon    4fedd31659ec010188335e09918c0000   (37)
#      Pune       7edfb62955d310014b6351f083a60000   (31)
#      Chennai    7edfb62955d310014b634f88574d0000   (24)
#      Noida      7babd3b910a21000e841d1c78e770000   (19)
#      Hyderabad  3b3fb1d62c071000e2a0f48656560000   (11)
#      Coimbatore ce4e62e669131000e2dc7e2e78a50000   (4)

# 3. All India roles (returns total:67) - paginate offset 0,20,40,60
curl -s -X POST 'https://fractal.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/fractal/Careers/jobs' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"appliedFacets":{"locations":["4fedd31659ec01018833637cbf900000","7edfb62955d310014b634f88574d0000","ce4e62e669131000e2dc7e2e78a50000","4fedd31659ec010188335e09918c0000","3b3fb1d62c071000e2a0f48656560000","4fedd31659ec01018833886e5c060000","7babd3b910a21000e841d1c78e770000","7edfb62955d310014b6351f083a60000"]},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":""}'

# 4. Mumbai only (returns total:43)
curl -s -X POST 'https://fractal.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/fractal/Careers/jobs' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"appliedFacets":{"locations":["4fedd31659ec01018833886e5c060000"]},"limit":20,"offset":0,"searchText":""}'

# 5. Full job detail incl. verbatim qualifications + additionalLocations + endDate
curl -s 'https://fractal.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/fractal/Careers/job/Bengaluru/Data-Modeller_SR-26412' -H 'Accept: application/json'
#    (path = each posting's "externalPath" field; jobPostingInfo.jobDescription holds the HTML)
#    NOTE: locationsText in the listing says e.g. "5 Locations" and hides Mumbai. You MUST fetch the
#    detail and read jobPostingInfo.additionalLocations to know if a role is really open in Mumbai.
#    A 403 on a detail URL means the req has been closed/pulled (e.g. SR-19434 Consultant-Decision Science).

# 6. Only ONE Workday site exists. Probed and 404'd: /Campus, /Internship, /University, /Students,
#    /External, /Fractal_Careers. fractal.ai/careers/ is a thin redirect shell to the same Workday tenant.
student_programs:
HARD FINDING: There is ZERO internship, graduate, trainee or campus requisition on Fractal's own Workday feed right now. I checked all 136 live reqs globally and all 67 India reqs; not one has "intern", "trainee", "graduate", "campus", "fresher" or "0-2 years" in the title or qualifications. The Workday search for "campus" returns total:0. There is no separate campus/university Workday site (I probed /Campus, /Internship, /University, /Students, /External and all returned 404). Internshala's Fractal Analytics employer page explicitly shows "No openings from Fractal Analytics at the moment."

WHAT EXISTS BUT IS CLOSED -- "Imagineers" (Fractal's flagship campus programme):
Fractal runs a graduate programme called "Imagineers (Data & AI Trainee)" with four tracks: Data Science, Data Engineering, Decision Sciences, and Data Visualisation (PowerBI/Tableau/custom UI). Per off-campus aggregator write-ups of the most recent drive (published 28 Jan 2026, offcampusjobs4u.com and knoffcampusjobs.com), the terms were: "2026 Pass-outs ONLY"; B.E/B.Tech circuit branches only (CS, IT, ECE, EEE, AI), or M.Sc / M.A in Economics or Statistics; "Minimum 7 CGPA throughout academics (10th, 12th, and Graduation)"; no active backlogs; joining locations Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Gurgaon, Noida; historic fresher range Rs 6-8 LPA; structure is roughly 12 weeks of pre-boarding training then a specialised track. Critically, the mode was "Employee Referral only -- no direct applications accepted", with a referral window of 28-30 January 2026 and a deadline of 30 January 2026.
STATUS RIGHT NOW: CLOSED. That drive was for the 2026 batch and the deadline passed ~8 months ago. I could find NO announcement of a 2027-batch Imagineers drive anywhere. Caveat: these are third-party aggregator pages, not a Fractal-owned URL -- I could not verify the terms against a Fractal domain, because Fractal does not publish Imagineers on its Workday site at all.

WHY THIS MATTERS FOR OMKAR: the Imagineers pipeline is REFERRAL-ONLY and announced with ~3 days of notice via WhatsApp/Telegram off-campus channels and employee referrals. That is the single highest-leverage path into Fractal for a May-2027 graduate, and it is invisible on the careers portal. The 2026 drive opened in late January; if the pattern repeats, the 2027-batch window is likely Dec 2026 - Feb 2027. He needs a warm Fractal contact lined up BEFORE then, because when it opens there is no public apply link. His profile clears the stated bar comfortably (DJSCE B.Tech CSE-Data Science is a circuit branch; CGPA 8.82 > 7.0; Python/SQL strong).

UNVERIFIED AGGREGATOR LISTINGS (present on third-party job boards, NOT on Fractal's own Workday feed -- treat as low confidence, possibly stale or scraped/reposted):
- "Growth Analytics Intern", Whitefield Bengaluru, 4 months, Rs 33K/month, 2 openings, in-office, listed on myinternships.in as actively recruiting on a rolling basis. Stated eligibility: "Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc/BCA/B.Com/BBA/MBA in any analytical discipline", 0 years experience, 2026 freshers and final-year students. Skills: "Product Analytics", "A/B Testing", "SQL", "Advanced Excel", "Data Analysis", "Power BI". Offers Certificate, LOR, and "Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) Opportunity". This is the single best-matched posting I found anywhere for his profile -- but Bengaluru, not Mumbai, and I could not corroborate it on any Fractal-controlled URL.
- "AI Engineer Intern (GenAI)", Bengaluru, and "HR Intern", Bengaluru -- same site, same caveat.
- placement-officer.com carries a historical "Fractal Analytics Internship Opportunities 2025 - Summer Intern in Mumbai" post, which confirms Fractal has run Mumbai summer internships in past cycles, but that cycle is over.

THE ONE THING HE CAN DO ON THE OFFICIAL SITE TODAY: Fractal appends this line to every single job description -- "Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!" That is https://fractal.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/Careers -> "Introduce Yourself". It is a talent-community capture, not an application, and by itself it is a black hole -- but it puts his profile in the Workday CRM that recruiters search when the Imagineers/campus req is raised, and it costs 10 minutes. Pair it with a referral, never rely on it alone.
limitations:
WHAT I GOT CLEANLY: Fractal's Workday CXS JSON API is fully open and unauthenticated. I enumerated ALL 136 live requisitions worldwide, applied the true location facet to isolate 67 India roles and 43 Mumbai roles, and pulled full verbatim job descriptions for 30 of them. Every role, job ID, URL and qualification line above is copied verbatim from that API. Nothing is reconstructed or paraphrased.

CORRECTION TO THE BRIEF'S ENDPOINT HINT: the hint said "94 India roles / 53 Mumbai". Both numbers are wrong, and I can show why. They came from searchText:"Mumbai" and searchText:"India", which in Workday is a fuzzy full-text relevance search across the whole description, not a location filter -- searchText:"Mumbai" returns 53 hits including "Senior GCP Engineer" with no location at all, and searchText:"India" returns 94 including New York and California roles. The correct method is the locations facet. True figures as of 24 Sep 2026: 67 India, 43 Mumbai.

A SECOND TRAP WORTH FLAGGING: the listing endpoint's locationsText field says things like "5 Locations" and never names them. Nineteen roles that look Bengaluru-only in the listing are in fact open in Mumbai, and you only discover that by fetching each detail and reading jobPostingInfo.additionalLocations. Any tool that filters on the listing alone will miss most of Fractal's Mumbai openings.

WHAT I COULD NOT GET, AND WHY:
1. NO INTERNSHIPS OR GRADUATE ROLES EXIST ON THE OFFICIAL FEED. This is a finding, not a gap -- I verified it four ways (all 136 reqs scanned; searchText "campus" returns 0; six alternate Workday site paths 404; Internshala's Fractal employer page says "No openings from Fractal Analytics at the moment"). I am not able to hand over a Fractal internship link because Fractal is not publishing one today.
2. The Imagineers graduate programme details are from THIRD-PARTY AGGREGATORS (offcampusjobs4u.com, knoffcampusjobs.com, apuzz.com, placement-officer.com), not a Fractal-owned URL. I could not corroborate the eligibility rules, CGPA cutoff, salary band or deadline against anything Fractal controls, because Fractal does not publish Imagineers on its careers site at all -- it runs referral-only. Treat those specifics as indicative, not authoritative. I found NO announcement of a 2027-batch drive; the 2026-batch window closed 30 Jan 2026.
3. The "Growth Analytics Intern" (Bengaluru, Rs 33K/month, 4 months, PPO opportunity) and "AI Engineer Intern (GenAI)" listings exist only on myinternships.in. I could not find them on Fractal's Workday, on LinkedIn's Fractal company page, or anywhere Fractal-controlled. They may be scraped, stale, or reposted by a third party. I have NOT verified them and he should not treat either as a confirmed live opening without contacting Fractal directly.
4. I did not scrape LinkedIn or Naukri job pages. Both block automated fetches and LinkedIn's "1000+ Fractal Analytics jobs in India" headline count is a platform aggregation artifact (it includes recruiter reposts, stale listings and roles at other firms), so it cannot be reconciled against the authoritative 67.
5. Three reqs carry imminent or ambiguous end dates I could not resolve further: SR-46203 (endDate 2026-09-25, i.e. tomorrow), SR-42058 (endDate 2026-09-30), and SR-16018 / SR-45903 / SR-20652 (all endDate 2026-11-30). Workday endDate is not always enforced, so "expires" is my reading of the field, not a confirmed closure.
6. A detail URL surfaced by web search -- /job/Consultant---Decision-Science_SR-19434 -- returns HTTP 403, meaning that req has been pulled. Search engines still index closed Fractal reqs, so any job ID found via Google must be re-verified against the API before being treated as live.

THE HONEST BOTTOM LINE ON FIT, WHICH THE ROLE LIST ALONE UNDERSTATES: of 67 live India requisitions, exactly ZERO are open to someone who has not yet graduated. The lowest years bar anywhere in India is 2-3 (SR-44168, and that one hard-requires CA/CMA/CFA/MBA); the lowest in the analytics and data family is 3+ (SR-26412). Five reqs state no years figure at all (SR-20652, SR-42761, SR-43347, SR-45548, SR-42058) and those are the only openings where a referral could plausibly carry a final-year student past the screen -- SR-20652 being the strongest of them, since it is dual-graded Data Scientist / Senior Data Scientist, is open in Mumbai, names no years anywhere, asks for exactly his degree, and lists a tech stack (LangChain, vector DBs, prompt engineering, FastAPI, Docker, Git) that his KOP AI and LawzyAI projects already cover. For a May-2027 graduate the realistic Fractal path is not the portal at all: it is a referral into the Imagineers 2027 drive, which if it follows the 2026 pattern opens around Dec 2026 - Feb 2027, accepts referrals only, and gives roughly three days of notice.
